doc.name: citepath
doc.description: Track and optimize how AI search engines cite, mention, and recommend your brand.

skills.name: check_ai_visibility
skills.description: How visible is a brand in AI answers? Given a domain, returns its latest public share-of-answer scan (how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok cite it, per engine, and which competitors they name instead) plus a live AI-crawler readiness audit. No scan id needed.

skills.name: get_readiness
skills.description: Run a crawler's-eye technical LLM readiness audit for a domain.

domain.description: The domain to audit, e.g. example.com

skills.name: get_scan
skills.description: Retrieve a finished public scan and its answers by scan ID.
